mentions.name: MakersHub.dev
mentions.description: A community platform for developers and creators building with AI tools, aimed at everyone from complete beginners exploring AI coding to experienced professionals showcasing advanced work. It offers learning guides, project showcases, discussions, a tools directory, and news.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the holidays I built MakersHub.dev – a community platform for developers and creators building with AI tools.
